notes.title: Message from the Developer
notes.notes:
Happy Wednesday, Residents!

I've got exciting news to share! The official gameplay trailer for My Trailer Park Life is now live on our Steam page! 🎉

As a solo developer, this is a huge milestone for me, and I'm so excited to finally give you a glimpse of what’s in store. The release is just around the corner, hope you're as excited as I am!

Go [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2481630/?utm_source=trailer]watch[/url] the trailer now.
And remember, keep an eye out for any Sasquatches! 👣👀

notes.title: Report for the Park Residents 0#
notes.notes:
[h2]Happy Friday, Residents![/h2]

We are very happy to deliver our first report to you. Our team has been progressing rapidly to fill any remaining holes and gaps in our Trailer Park. 

As we prepare for your arrival, we have informed your [i]NPC neighbours[/i], handed out the best insurance deals to [i]small businesses[/i] and informed the [i]local police[/i] force, to ensure you will have no issues while moving into our park. 

Watch out for Sasquatches!
